items.html:
Feiko is another contender for the opening position and his ability to bowl
his medium pacers in the middle of the innings should make him a firm
candidate for this position. Solid in the field, Feiko can field both close
to the wicket and in in the outfield. Feiko comes to his best in nail-biting
finishes.
Toured England in 1995 with the
Netherlands A side.
